description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

You emit a sensual aura that is @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.6l3jvIAvrKxt0lA9]{Attractive} to all living creatures. Any living creature within Willpower Bonus yards must pass an Average (+20) Willpower Test each Round or move to stand next to you. They will grapple with anyone restraining them to achieve this. Once next to you, they gain the @Condition[Surprised] Condition and just stand very still, awaiting pleasure or pain as you decide. It’s almost impossible for you to not draw the attention of others and you get a -20 Stealth modifier around sentient beings that are within your Willpower yards. Tantalising Aura doesn’t cause Fear in others (see @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.journal.JournalEntry.uDGFazW9Nr0N6ABS.JournalEntryPage.9sK84Dvy3Ng36qXp#reactions-to-mutations]{Reactions to Mutations}).
